name: imagen
description: Generate images through an OpenAI-compatible image or chat endpoint.

IMAGEN_API_KEY.title: Imagen API key
IMAGEN_API_KEY.description: API key for the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

IMAGEN_API_URL.title: Imagen API URL
IMAGEN_API_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Include the /v1 path, for example https://api.openai.com/v1.

IMAGEN_REQUEST_MODE.title: Imagen request mode
IMAGEN_REQUEST_MODE.description: Select the image generations endpoint or the chat completions endpoint.
